data_source: Tick/M1 intrabar path source is required but not yet selected; broker feed, Strategy Tester export, or exported bars/ticks must be fixed in F86B.
time_axis_boundary: timestamp_utc remains broker-clock alignment key, not true UTC authority, until time-axis contract audit confirms ordering. F86B must lock tick/M1 order and bar open/close convention.
sample_scope: FPMarkets US100 M5; concrete date range, tiers, row counts, and exclusions are pending F86B data source lock.
missing_or_duplicate_check: Pending F86B tick/M1 coverage, duplicate timestamp, gap policy, and Tier A/B/combined status checks.
feature_label_boundary: first-touch/both-hit order, post-entry excursion, and runtime close result are label-only/diagnostic-only until leakage audit; they cannot enter features.
split_boundary: pre-registered train/validation/OOS or WFO split required before selection. OOS locked readout cannot feed tuning.
leakage_checks: feature timestamp must be <= entry decision timestamp
no post-entry path or realized runtime result in features
no F85 ex-post runtime label as direct filter
leakage_risk: Highest risk is intrabar first-touch/both-hit order leaking post-entry path into pre-entry features.
missing_data_boundary: Missing tick/M1 identity is not invalid for F86A design, but blocks proxy/runtime claims until resolved.
